translations.translatedText: # Thursday 21.7.2022
The ECB raises interest rates. UPM had a good result. Britain has 2 candidates for prime minister. Fewer children were born in Finland than ever before. The weather is warm.
## TV's Clear News has a summer break 6.6.–12.8.Read and listen to the radio broadcast here.Interest rates

![The main building of the European Central Bank, photographed across the River Main.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_3860,h_2171,x_0,y_46/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-89562061c313531cf08/1640174509)
Open image viewer
The main building of the ECB. Photo: Esa Syväkuru / Yle
The European Central Bank (ECB) raises interest rates. This is the first time in over 10 years that the ECB raises interest rates.
The ECB is trying to reduce inflation, that is, the rise in prices. Prices have risen quickly in Europe.
## UPM
![UPM factory.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5460,h_3071,x_0,y_178/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-954754627e45c8735bd/1710232390)
Open image viewer
UPM factory. Photo: Kalle Niskala / Yle
The forest company UPM has had a good result. Between April and June, UPM made almost 390 million euros in profit.
UPM expects that the whole year's result for the company will also be better than in previous years.
## Britain's prime minister

![Rishi Sunak and Liz Truss appeared in a candidate debate on television.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4375,h_2460,x_0,y_161/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-98442662d8252cb05fd/1658332549)
Open image viewer

Britain's next prime minister is either Rishi Sunak (left) or Liz Truss (right). At the weekend's candidate debate they clashed fiercely. Photo: JONATHAN HORDLE / ITV / HANDOUT / EPA-EFE/All Over Press

Britain's next prime minister is either the former finance minister Rishi Sunak or the foreign minister Liz Truss. Sunak and Truss got through to the next round in the vote of the Conservative Party of Britain. The party will choose a new prime minister by 5 September.
Britain's prime minister is changing, because Boris Johnson is resigning from the post of prime minister.
## Babies
![A baby lies in a cot and looks sleepy.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_1919,h_1080,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-97373062b311f505178/1655902858)
Open image viewer
Fewer children were born in Finland during the start of the year than ever before. Photo: Rami Moilanen / Yle
Fewer children were born in Finland during the start of the year than ever before.
Statistics Finland says that between January and June, 22 180 children were born. Almost 2 500 fewer children were born than at the same time in 2021.
Last year more than 4300 more people lived in Finland than a year earlier. The reason is that more people moved to Finland from abroad than moved from Finland abroad.
## World Athletics Championships
![Viivi Lehikoinen ran a new Finnish record.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5032,h_2830,x_0,y_174/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-98459862d9035d6631e/1660732900)
Open image viewer
Viivi Lehikoinen ran a new Finnish record. Photo: Lehtikuva
At the athletics world championships in the USA, Viivi Lehikoinen ran a new Finnish record in the 400 metre hurdles. Lehikoinen's time was not enough for the final.

Early on Friday, the javelin throw will take place at the athletics world championships. Three Finns are in the javelin qualifying round. Trying for a place in the final are Oliver Helander, Lassi Etelätalo and Toni Keränen.
## Blue-green algae

![Blue-green algae in the sea area in front of Naantali, aerial photo.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5472,h_3078,x_0,y_98/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-98463462d90f8847077/1658393113)
Open image viewer
Blue-green algae in the sea area in front of Naantali, aerial photo. Photo: Veijo Lindgren
There is a lot of blue-green algae in some places in the sea.
There is a lot of blue-green algae especially along the coasts of the Archipelago Sea and the Gulf of Finland. There is also more blue-green algae on the coast of the Bothnian Sea than before.
In lakes there is less blue-green algae than usual at this time of year.
## The weather

![A sun umbrella has been put up in a day-care centre yard to shade the sandbox.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_3308,h_1863,x_0,y_465/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-98067462cc340f1d104/1657550003)
Open image viewer
A sun umbrella has been put up in the yard of a day-care centre to shade the sandbox. Photo: Marianne Ukskoski / Perho municipality
The weather is warm.
Almost all over Finland it is dry and the sun shines. On Friday in the afternoon it rains now and then in the west and in Kainuu.
On Friday it is over 20 degrees in almost the whole country. In places it is even 30 degrees warm.
